title: MedicineTraceability batch registration data
description: Flat BatchData input tuple. Custody, recall and history are contract-derived and must not be supplied as registration input.
$comment: Validate manufacturedAt <= chain time < expiresAt and manufacturedAt < expiresAt at submission; draft-07 cannot express these cross-field/time rules. Contract validation remains authoritative. Numbers use the JavaScript safe-integer subset of uint256.

batchId.description: Case-sensitive unique string; do not trim or transform identifiers.

manufacturedAt.description: Unix seconds, not milliseconds; must not be in the future.

expiresAt.description: Unix seconds strictly after manufacture and registration block time.

documentReference.description: IPFS CID or ipfs:// reference. CID syntax, availability and document authenticity require separate validation.

certificateReference.description: IPFS CID or ipfs:// reference. Must be validated and pinned by the document service.
